risks.title: Insurance Underwriting and Mortality Risk
risks.score_rationale: Globe Life is a life and supplemental health insurer. Adverse mortality, morbidity or persistency trends directly impact reserves and profitability. COVID-era spikes demonstrated material sensitivity to pandemic-driven mortality.
risks.summary: Adverse deviations in mortality, morbidity, lapse or claims experience versus pricing assumptions could require reserve strengthening and reduce earnings.

risks.title: Investment Portfolio and Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The insurance reserves are backed by a large fixed-income portfolio. Sustained low or volatile rates pressure net investment income while credit spread widening can impair holdings.
risks.summary: Changes in interest rates, credit spreads or defaults in the corporate bond portfolio can reduce investment income and statutory capital.

risks.title: Independent Agent Distribution Model
risks.score_rationale: Globe Life relies heavily on exclusive agencies (American Income, Liberty National, Family Heritage). Recruitment, retention and productivity of agents drives new annualized premium growth.
risks.summary: Difficulty recruiting and retaining captive independent agents, or misconduct by agents, could reduce sales growth and trigger reputational or legal exposure.

risks.title: Regulatory and Legal Proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Following 2024 short-seller allegations, the company faces heightened litigation and regulatory scrutiny over sales practices and agency oversight. Insurance regulation is state-by-state and intensive.
risks.summary: Class actions, securities suits and regulatory investigations relating to sales practices or disclosures could result in material settlements, fines and remediation costs.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: Holds sensitive personal health and financial information of policyholders. Item 1A specifically flags cybersecurity events as potentially material.
risks.summary: Cyberattacks, ransomware or breaches of policyholder data could trigger regulatory penalties, litigation, remediation costs and brand damage.

risks.title: Capital, Reinsurance and Rating Agency Risk
risks.score_rationale: RBC ratios and AM Best / S&P financial strength ratings drive cost of capital and policyholder confidence. Reinsurance counterparty failure would expose retained risk.
risks.summary: Downgrades to financial strength ratings or impairment of reinsurance recoverables could increase capital requirements and reduce competitiveness.
